steps.title: Validate the classroom scenario
steps.explanation: The browser selects a fixed experiment; it cannot inject agent definitions, model IDs, task prompts or arbitrary paths.
steps.narration: Step 1. The browser selects a fixed experiment; it cannot inject agent definitions, model IDs, task prompts or arbitrary paths. This source excerpt shows the corresponding application statement.

steps.title: Define when and how a specialist works
steps.code:
"code-reviewer": {
      description:
        "Read-only classroom code reviewer. Use to inspect auth.cjs for the deliberately flawed role check.",
      prompt:
        "Read auth.cjs once. Identify why not-admin is incorrectly accepted. Do not modify files or run commands. Report under 50 words.",
steps.explanation: description guides specialist selection; prompt defines its role and behavior. These required fields serve different purposes.
steps.narration: Step 2. description guides specialist selection; prompt defines its role and behavior. These required fields serve different purposes. This source excerpt shows the corresponding application statement.

steps.title: Choose child tools and model
steps.explanation: Give the reviewer a read-only tool set. The model comparison changes its model override while the task and fixture remain fixed.
steps.narration: Step 3. Give the reviewer a read-only tool set. The model comparison changes its model override while the task and fixture remain fixed. This source excerpt shows the corresponding application statement.

steps.title: Attach definitions and enable Agent
steps.code:
agents:
        c.mode === "filesystem" || c.mode === "builtin"
          ? undefined
          : definitions(cheap),
      tools: ["Agent", "Read", "Grep", "Glob", "Bash"],
      allowedTools: ["Agent", "Read", "Grep", "Glob", "Bash"],
      permissionMode: "dontAsk",
      settingSources: ["project"],
steps.explanation: Programmatic modes pass the agents option and allow the actual Agent tool. Filesystem and built-in modes omit programmatic definitions.
steps.narration: Step 4. Programmatic modes pass the agents option and allow the actual Agent tool. Filesystem and built-in modes omit programmatic definitions. This source excerpt shows the corresponding application statement.

steps.title: Observe a native delegation
steps.explanation: Detect top-level Agent tool-use blocks and retain their actual IDs and delegation inputs. A parent answer alone is not proof of delegation.
steps.narration: Step 5. Detect top-level Agent tool-use blocks and retain their actual IDs and delegation inputs. A parent answer alone is not proof of delegation. This source excerpt shows the corresponding application statement.

steps.title: Observe a real specialist start
steps.explanation: Native start hooks identify the actual child and its start time. Independent start/stop events allow inspection of requested concurrency.
steps.narration: Step 6. Native start hooks identify the actual child and its start time. Independent start/stop events allow inspection of requested concurrency. This source excerpt shows the corresponding application statement.

steps.title: Constrain reads and test execution
steps.explanation: Permit only the exact classroom test command. Read and scan capabilities remain inside the isolated fixture project; edits are rejected.
steps.narration: Step 7. Permit only the exact classroom test command. Read and scan capabilities remain inside the isolated fixture project; edits are rejected. This source excerpt shows the corresponding application statement.

steps.title: Correlate child tools with the Agent call
steps.explanation: Child tool-use messages carry parent_tool_use_id. Correlate the nested activity with the originating Agent tool ID.
steps.narration: Step 8. Child tool-use messages carry parent_tool_use_id. Correlate the nested activity with the originating Agent tool ID. This source excerpt shows the corresponding application statement.

steps.title: Separate child text from parent output
steps.explanation: Forwarded child text is shown in host telemetry; parent assistant text is rendered separately. Host observability is not the parent model’s full context.
steps.narration: Step 9. Forwarded child text is shown in host telemetry; parent assistant text is rendered separately. Host observability is not the parent model’s full context. This source excerpt shows the corresponding application statement.

steps.title: Recognize the Agent tool return
steps.explanation: Record actual Agent returns. A foreground return may contain the final report; background launches can be receipts followed by native completion notifications.
steps.narration: Step 10. Record actual Agent returns. A foreground return may contain the final report; background launches can be receipts followed by native completion notifications. This source excerpt shows the corresponding application statement.

steps.title: Capture native child completion
steps.explanation: Record the native stop event and its final assistant message when provided. Preserve lifecycle timing instead of inventing progress.
steps.narration: Step 11. Record the native stop event and its final assistant message when provided. Preserve lifecycle timing instead of inventing progress. This source excerpt shows the corresponding application statement.

steps.title: Observe filesystem agent definitions
steps.code:
join(cwd, ".claude", "agents", "file-reviewer.md"),
    "---
name: file-reviewer
description: Classroom read-only code reviewer.
tools: Read
model: inherit
---
Read auth.cjs once. Identify the substring role-check bug. Do not modify files. Report under 50 words.",
  );
steps.explanation: Create a real project Markdown agent definition. Project setting sources let the SDK discover it, while programmatic agents are omitted in that mode.
steps.narration: Step 12. Create a real project Markdown agent definition. Project setting sources let the SDK discover it, while programmatic agents are omitted in that mode. This source excerpt shows the corresponding application statement.

steps.title: Verify the fixture remains unchanged
steps.explanation: Independently hash both fixture and tests after all reports. A successful reviewer result must not imply unobserved edits or fabricated test execution.
steps.narration: Step 13. Independently hash both fixture and tests after all reports. A successful reviewer result must not imply unobserved edits or fabricated test execution. This source excerpt shows the corresponding application statement.
